Effect: [On Play] By placing 1 card from your hand face down under any of your Tamers with the [DATA SQUAD] trait, ＜Draw 2＞. (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your hand has 7 or fewer cards, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
